Summary: Course Progress Update — AI & Python Technology Course

Authoritative data: 41 topics total, 22 completed, 19 not started, 53.7% completion rate. Scope includes: learntrack_topics.json creation and validation; progress calculation engine; course dashboard and topic-list UI; automated tests and regression coverage; build variants, quality gates, and CI/CD pipeline; Kiro specs, steering files, and reusable skills; Google Stitch and Figma design handoff; Jira traceability; and release-readiness report.
Acceptance Criteria: All 11 stories (LT-001 through LT-011) are complete and their acceptance criteria pass. learntrack_topics.json contains exactly 41 topics with 22 completed and 19 not_started. The displayed completion percentage is 53.7%. The app builds without errors (assembleDebug). All unit and UI tests pass. Lint reports no errors. A release-readiness report confirms all gates passed. No Jira issues were fabricated — only CSV files were generated.
